evidence.excerpt: Multimodal Agentic Retrieval (MAR) requires agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks by iteratively invoking external tools.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Continued image retention is associated with higher output entropy and can even degrade task accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Experiments on seven MAR benchmarks across five backbone models show that MM-ContextFold improves average accuracy by 6.3 percentage points over ReAct while reducing the working context length by 27.5\%.
